policy: A claim is verified only when the harness executes the claimed operation and asserts its expected observable. Source-string checks, unconditional passes, existence-only checks, and assertions weaker than the stated acceptance are downgraded. This is the final audit after the 2026-10-31 wave repairs; the earlier 18-claim audit is retained as history.

downgrades.reason: The registry contains postcondition verifiers for only trigger_workflow and tasks.create; the README's 'every mutating action is re-derived' is not established.
OIDC config round-trips and the secret is hidden, but login returned 503 and no IdP callback/session was completed.
A contract with one accountable-agent field was constructed; exactly-one accounting is not validated or enforced at the delegation boundary.
The alignment sweep was run manually with a controlled chat function; the opt-in nightly automation path was not exercised.
Provider configuration and masking were read; a route from a key stored through the Settings surface was not exercised without a restart.
